about: Settings pages and rows from the answers file (2026-11-17-g4-g5-answers.md), config.xml keys as the C1 gate fixes them. initial is the config value before the run, set is what the control is given, expect is the config value after. The Keys page has no control.

rows.label: Post-AI mode
rows.description: A plain terminal with tabs and splits. No agents, no AI features.

rows.label: Restore layout
rows.description: Reopen the last tabs and splits when Clanky starts.

rows.label: New windows open with
rows.description: Applies to the next new window. A restored layout keeps its own panes.

rows.label: Robot greeting
rows.description: The robot says hello when a window opens.

rows.label: Animations
rows.description: Motion in the window, the robot's greeting included.

rows.label: Notify after
rows.description: A notice when a command runs this long, in seconds.

rows.label: Columns
rows.description: Width of a new window in characters. Applies to new windows.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: Height of a new window in lines. Applies to new windows.

rows.label: Tab style
rows.description: Tabs across the top, or a list down the left with folder, branch and last command.

rows.label: Tools panel
rows.description: A panel on the left. Ctrl+Shift+B shows it or puts it away.

rows.label: Command input
rows.description: An editor under each pane, or the shell's own prompt.

rows.label: Blocks
rows.description: Quiet hairlines between commands, or framed blocks.

rows.label: Status line
rows.description: Session, server and masking, in one row at the bottom.

rows.label: Follow the system
rows.description: Use one theme in dark mode and another in light mode.

rows.label: Font size
rows.description: Ctrl + and Ctrl - change it for one window.

rows.label: Terminal font
rows.description: Used in every terminal pane.

rows.label: Interface font
rows.description: Used for menus, tabs and Settings.

rows.label: Cell width
rows.description: Wider cells space the letters out, as in Ptyxis.

rows.label: Line height
rows.description: Taller rows space the lines out, as in Ptyxis.

rows.label: Opacity
rows.description: How much of the desktop shows through.

rows.label: Cursor blink
rows.description: System follows the GNOME setting.

rows.label: Blink cycle
rows.description: One full blink, shown and hidden, in milliseconds.

rows.label: Stop blinking after
rows.description: Seconds after the last key press.

rows.label: Clipboard writes
rows.description: Programs in the terminal may copy text (OSC 52).

rows.label: Clipboard reads
rows.description: Programs in the terminal may read what you copied.

rows.label: Dictionary
rows.description: The spelling language of the compose editor.

rows.label: Dictionary folder
rows.description: Where the spelling dictionaries are.

rows.label: Enter after send
rows.description: Press Enter in the pane after a draft is sent.

rows.label: New agent panes
rows.description: What an agent started in a new pane may do.

rows.label: Save history
rows.description: Keep commands and their output on this computer.

rows.label: Keep for
rows.description: Days of saved history. Zero keeps everything.

rows.label: Output per command
rows.description: The output saved with each command, in KiB.
